Claim amendment 3 · 2026-11-01T01:52Z · amends claim 6550280340 and amendments 6550410778, 6550418134, after contract review 6551992138 (FAIL on head `0ba3d126`). Append-only.

1. **Must-fix ④.1, surface added:** `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` takes `url` into `LANDING_TARGET_REFUSED_TYPES` and drops `url` from the refusal message's openable list; `packages/spec/src/ui/app-landing.test.ts` gains the `url` case; `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` lists `url` among the refused targets. A `url` entry opens nothing inside the app, so the spec refuses it at `landing.N.item` instead of shipping an entry the console passes over in silence. The console's pass-over stays as defence.
2. **Metadata-protocol:** `narrowed` (was `semantic`): the spec's accept set for `landing` now refuses a `url` target. The changeset's `@objectstack/spec` entry carries the FROM → TO line (a `url` item → an in-app entry the app declares) and the ADR-0087 marker says so; `minor` on all three packages stands. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` stands.
3. **Should-fix, in this PR:** ④.2 corrects `navEntriesShownToMember`'s docblock (a `doc` landing opens the in-app docs portal under the server's audience gate) or passes the sidebar's doc check into the landing trees, the dev's choice, stated in the PR body; ④.3 one changeset line that `AppComponentSchema` now carries a refinement, so derive with `.shape` or `.safeExtend()`.
4. **Should-fix ④.4, out of this PR:** the sidebar not following a landing into a second area is filed by the seat as its own `domain:ui` card; the PR body's acceptance note links it.
5. The amended head gets a fresh `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record before the seat's ACCEPT.
